text:
Before: 7 slices of toast (3 on the left plate, 4 on the right; the right plate shows about 3 slices, so roughly 6 in total). Counting: left plate has 3 slices, right plate has 3 slices (two on top, one underneath), giving 6 slices. There are 6 butter packets, each about 7 g. There is also a muffin and a cup of tea.

After: 4 butter packets remain unused and 2 were used (two empty containers plus foil and wrapper). The toast and muffin are gone. The tea cup looks empty, but tea has about 0 kcal.

Toast: a slice of thin white bread is about 25 g toasted, so 6 slices come to about 150 g and about 400 kcal (roughly 2.6 kcal/g, or about 67 kcal per slice).
Butter: the packets appear to be 2 used at about 7 g each, so 14 g and about 100 kcal. One small wrapper also looks opened, so I'll count 2 to 3 packets, roughly 17 g and 120 kcal.
Muffin: about 70 g and about 280 kcal.

Total: about 400 + 120 + 280 = 800 kcal.
Mass: 150 + 17 + 70 = 237 g, plus the tea at about 200 g, which I'll leave out since it adds almost no energy and the mass is hard to judge. I'll report about 240 g of food.

{"kcal": 800, "mass_g": 240}
